{"id":1563678483,"question_id":3,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 4 months","timestamp":1741175139,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"3 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1563678483/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters","memory":"11.9 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int lengthOfLongestSubstring(string s) {\n        unordered_map<char, int> mapping;\n        int maxLength = 0, i = 0;\n\n        for (int j = 0; j < s.length(); j++) \n        {\n            if (mapping.find(s[j]) != mapping.end()) \n            {\n                i = max(mapping[s[j]] + 1, i);  // Move left pointer to avoid duplicates\n            }\n            mapping[s[j]] = j;  // Store the last seen index of the character\n            maxLength = max(maxLength, j - i + 1);\n        }\n\n        return maxLength;\n    }\n};\n","compare_result":"","title_slug":"longest-substring-without-repeating-characters","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":407}
